summary: Dick's Sporting Goods filed an 8-K to report Q2 fiscal 2026 results and declare a quarterly dividend of $1.25 per share on common and Class B stock, payable September 25, 2026, to holders of record September 11, 2026. The earnings release notes a 4.9% comp sales growth for the Dick's business, with diluted EPS of $3.50 (non-GAAP $3.53) compared to $4.71 prior year, including a dilutive impact from a previously completed Foot Locker acquisition. The filing is routine operational reporting and standard dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. What to watch: ongoing performance of the Foot Locker integration amid a challenging athletic footwear market, and any changes to the revised 2026 outlook.
